# Wharf 0.11.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Admission order is stable by attempt ID and remains work-conserving.
- Active trials never exceed the configured concurrency limit.
- Total started trials never exceed the configured maximum.
- Successful logical attempts are banked immediately and later duplicates are
  skipped.
- Lifecycle transitions are observable through the event sink.
- Cancellation prevents new admissions and marks pending work cancelled.
- Retry classification and phase-specific resources remain intentionally
  deferred.

## Validation evidence

Formatting verification, Release build, and the complete suite passed all 60
tests with zero warnings or errors.
